main.description: Ciphertext-only attachment manifest written into a conversation Space or personal mailbox Space BEFORE sending an MLS message referencing the blob (Gate 5). Committing this record with a standard ATProto blob ref promotes the uploaded encrypted blob from .staged to .space on the writer's PDS so com.atproto.sync.getBlob returns 404 while Space credential holders can read com.atproto.space.getBlob.

blob.description: Opaque AES-256-GCM encrypted attachment blob reference.

sha256.description: Raw SHA-256 digest of the encrypted blob bytes.

ciphertextSize.description: Exact byte length of the encrypted blob.
